clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country in March 1952 and the purchase of the orchard, within the year: June became homesick and wrote to her sister daily; Walter spent long hours out in the trees and distanced from June; Glen got into fights at school; Walter cut off his brother Harlan over a quarrel about their father's land money; June kept to her bed for weeks that winter; Walter and June rowed over money for new trees; by September June joined the church choir and her letters to Edna thinned out, where the period settles.

clusters.name: The orchard failed, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when a late frost destroyed the crop and the bank called in the loan, within the year: Walter drank heavily; he and Glen blamed each other over the loan; Glen and Marian took over the family's money and talks with the bank; Carl's asthma attacks worsened; Nora began wetting the bed; Ida's heart trouble was found and she stopped working; by October Walter stopped drinking and took work pruning other men's trees, where the period settles.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975, within months: Glen sat out of work in the truck for hours; he and Marian fought loudly over money at night; Marian took a second job cleaning offices; Nora stopped eating and lost weight; Nora kept to her room and distanced from Marian; Walter drank again after six years; by June 1976 Nora was eating again and made the track team, where the period settles.

clusters.name: Wilma moved into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma selling her farm and moving into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990, within months: Nora and Wilma clashed over the children's bedtimes and meals; Hollis worked late and kept out of the kitchen rows; Hollis took his mother's side; Owen had tantrums at preschool; Wilma took over Lily's care; Nora's eczema flared on both hands; Nora and Hollis rowed most nights; by August 1991 Nora's eczema cleared, where the period settles, within a few months of Wilma taking a flat in town in June.

clusters.name: Tess's drinking and troubles, 1996–1997
clusters.reason: Around Tess drinking most nights beginning in October 1996, within the year: Nora phoned Tess every night, worried for her; Tess and Rick had shouting matches and he slept at his brother's; by June 1997 Tess stopped drinking and went to meetings twice a week, where the period settles. Marian's overfunctioning sits beside these months but its date is unknown, so it belongs in the period without opening it.

periods.words: The one that stands out is the year Dad lost his job, when I was 14.

declined.reason: An acute episode: four days in August 1994, from the wildfire coming over the ridge to the family allowed home and calm again within the week, is an acute episode around a real threat, not a period.
